rationale: Abstract: outcomes were the "Shoulder Pain and Disability Index (SPADI) and Range of Motion (ROM) assessments"; no motivation instrument anywhere in Methods or Results (motivation appears only in the Introduction and Conclusion as a claim).

Instrument is the Intrinsic Motivation Inventory: "Four subscales relevant to the study aims were assessed: Interest/Enjoyment, Perceived Competence, Effort/Importance, and Value/Usefulness." Results for Wii Fit arm and wobble-board (non-exergame) arm, Table 2: "Interest/Enjoyment 5.04 ± 1.18 3.17 ± 1.31". Wii Fit group 4 weeks, 12 sessions; published 2026, no earlier report named.
doubt: I2: allocation was "using a pseudo-randomized procedure constrained to produce approximately equal group sizes" yet the design is labelled quasi-experimental/TREND; included under amendment A3 but the line between pseudo-randomized and non-random is unclear. I6: IMI was given only to the two training groups (not the no-training control), so the non-exergame arm in I6 is the wobble-board arm; also Table 2 gives N=12 gamified vs text n=9.

rationale: Methods: "The primary outcomes were pain intensity measured using the Visual Analog Scale and functional"; secondary outcomes ROM and SF-12; no motivation instrument was measured.
doubt: I1: unclear whether the immersive VR therapeutic exercises had a game goal or score; not decided because E5 applies regardless.

rationale: Methods 2.1: "Each week comprised a single exercise session (AVG or RUN) and a subsequent" blood draw; crossover with one 30-minute session per condition. Also no motivation instrument (outcomes are blood markers, HR, VO2).
doubt: I7: the reference list cites an earlier 2023 report of what may be the same registered trial (ref 29); not resolved because the record is excluded on E4.
